research_question: Do the HSLS:09 mathematics self-efficacy and utility scales measure the same constructs equivalently across student sex and socioeconomic status - item functioning (DIF) and measurement invariance evidence for two scales widely used as predictors in EDM research?
factor_model:
EFF =~ S1MTESTS + S1MTEXTBOOK + S1MSKILLS + S1MASSEXCL
UTI =~ S1MUSELIFE + S1MUSECLG + S1MUSEJOB
grouping_notes: X1SEX: Male/Female labels. X1SESQ5: use the two extreme quintiles (First quintile (lowest) vs Fifth quintile (highest)) as the DIF/invariance groups; other rows keep NaN group.
target_population: HSLS:09 ninth graders enrolled in a fall 2009 mathematics course (item legitimate skips excluded by design)
known_concerns_to_flag: PSY-01 legit-skip missingness: claims describe enrolled students
PSY-04 X1SESQ5 has 5 levels: extremes-only grouping must be named
